title: Woman Leaning on Apartment Wall, 1936 Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length snapshot photo taken in April 1936 featuring a young woman leaning against the exterior wall of Grande Park Apartments. She wears a buttoned short-sleeved blouse, light mid-length skirt, and dark pumps with straps, typical of mid-1930s casual fashion. The snapshot is decorated with a distinct Art Deco border frame.
